summary: Scancode-to-ASCII keyboard translation. For scancode inputs in the negative signed-char range (from 0x80 upward), a large switch over jump table 0x00455868 maps each scancode to a fixed ASCII value. For all other inputs, when the extended-key flag (a2 & 0x8000) is clear the scancode passes through unchanged; otherwise a second switch over (a2 & 0xFFF) via jump table 0x00455A5C maps extended scancodes to ASCII, folding the shift modifier state carried in bits a2>>10 and a2>>11 into the result. Called by TranslateVirtualKey (0x00455B30).

operations.description: Switch on a1: negative scancodes (-128..-1) map to fixed ASCII characters, dispatched through the jump table at 0x00455868.
For unlisted scancodes, test the extended-key flag: when (a2 & 0x8000) == 0, return a1 unchanged.

When the extended-key flag is set, switch on (a2 & 0xFFF) through the jump table at 0x00455A5C, mapping extended scancodes to ASCII with the shift-state bits (a2 >> 10) and (a2 >> 11) folded into the result (e.g. uppercase base ORed with the 0x20/0x10 case bit).
Invoked by TranslateVirtualKey (0x00455B30) to obtain the printable character for a virtual-key scancode.
